shortDescription: West African crude market was quiet on Tuesday, while traders awaited results of a tender.

children: West African crude market was quiet on Tuesday, while traders awaited results of a tender.
The market was watching for results from a recent Pertamina tender, a trader said. The market was otherwise relatively quiet, he added.
Traders were also awaiting Angola's loading programme for December.
West African crude grades have been under pressure as record-high freight rates have hampered demand for grades that usually travel long-haul to their main demand outlets.

In wider news, China - a top buyer of West African crude - imported 2.42 million barrels per day (bpd) from top supplier Russia, up 20% from a year earlier but down 11% from the previous month, customs data showed. Imports from Angola fell 57% in September from last year.
